scenario: asking for help with personal care services
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Personal Care Services
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: personal care services — asking for help with personal care services
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with personal care services; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Michael to help her choose a new hairstyle.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ anh Michael giúp chọn kiểu tóc mới.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Michael, can you help me choose a new hairstyle?
turns.vietnamese: Michael này, anh giúp tôi chọn kiểu tóc mới được không?

turns.speaker: Mr Michael
turns.english: Yes, this style would suit you.
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, kiểu này hợp với chị đấy.
